Definition: from a derivative of G5180 (meaning a drum, "tympanum"); to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death:--torture.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tympanízō is the word for to torture on the rack. In Hebrews 11:35, others were tortured.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tortured ones of Hebrews 11 refused deliverance for a better resurrection, and their faith shames my comfort.
